nodes.label: pair-and-converse Maestro flow (Android device journey)
nodes.rationale: Written against the SHARED test ids so the same selectors describe the same elements on iOS; MainActivity's testTagsAsResourceId=true is what publishes Compose testTags to Maestro. Env values are substituted by scripts/test-android.sh rather than declared as `env:` defaults, because maestro preferred the defaults over -e overrides and typed '…/pair?t=unset'. App data is cleared before maestro starts (pm clear drops the adb transport and maestro's own clearState died 'device offline'). Pairing uses the manual paste field, not the supermux://pair deep link, because the link is only read by ConnectPage — the last of four intro pages — and is consumed while page 0 is showing on a fresh install.
